referenceSource.scope: Read native-chat support and provider vault parsers; verified adapters against installed local record shapes. Vault parser support alone does not prove live native chat.

method: Read audit.txt containing 42 in isolated temporary workspaces, then return the fixed answer marker. Actual node-pty launches; no user project was used for model writes. Credentials and private conversation text are not included here. Some CLI startup/update prompts caused provider-managed auto updates; versions before/after are recorded.

limits: Fresh Kimi/OpenCode/Devin/Antigravity/ZCode PTYs can remain unbound until an exact provider session ID is available. Never select the newest session in the working directory.
SQLite adapters use the sqlite3 executable in asynchronous read-only mode. Verified on this Mac; other desktop platforms require that executable.
Alternate-screen TUIs retain their native terminal behavior instead of applying the normal-buffer folding overlay. Unknown headings remain visible.
Login, quota, and CLI installation/configuration failures are separate from transcript-parser compatibility.
OpenCode adapter covers the locally verified message/part schema; a different future schema requires a separate adapter.
